extracted text: The SU-57 series was prepared hydro(solvo)-thermally, using ethanol, distilled water, ethylenediamine (EDA, 99%), germanium dioxide, tetraethyl orthosilicate (TEOS) and aluminum isopropoxide (Al(OC3H7)3), as starting materials. The materials were mixed with molar ratios of 116H2O:72C2H5OH:62EDA:1GeO2:1TEOS:2Al(OC3H7)3, and the resulting suspension was stirred for at least 30 min. The mixture was transferred to a Teflon-lined steel autoclave, and heated at 160 or 170°C for 7 days. The products were collected by filtration and washed first with deionized water and then with ethanol. We found that the presence of ethanol was essential for the formation of SU-57.
property mapping:
H2O: 116 moles of water
EDA (ethylenediamine): 62 moles, serves as the structure directing agent (osda)
GeO2: 1 mole, source of Ge
TEOS (tetraethyl orthosilicate): 1 mole, source of Si
Al(OC3H7)3 (aluminum isopropoxide): 2 moles, source of Al
C2H5OH (ethanol): 72 moles
Temperature: 160 or 170°C (mean: 165°C)
Time: 7 days (168 hours)
formula abbreviations:
EDA = ethylenediamine (C2H10N2)
TEOS = tetraethyl orthosilicate (Si(OC2H5)4), source of Si
Al(OC3H7)3 = aluminum isopropoxide, source of Al

C2H5OH = ethanol
